summary: Frontend-only visual+DOM validation of /orders per user layout spec. Ran Playwright at 390/768/900/1920 signed-out and signed-in (aarohi@cleliastudio-demo.com). Sticky 60px header renders on every width; overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth) = 0 in all 6 checks. Back link's <span>'Back to designer' correctly hides via display:none below 480px while arrow remains; account button visible on every width; menu opens with Sign In / Create Account / Staff Login (signed-out) and Your Clelia account / My Designs / My Orders / Profile & Address / Staff Login / Sign Out (signed-in). Populated view (3 seeded sample orders) renders 'My Orders' title then responsive card grid: 1 col at 390, 2 col at 900 and 1920, cards inside 1100px container with 24px/48px padding. Signed-out empty-state renders but violates the single-empty-state and champagne-circle spec (see bugs).

ui_bugs.issue:
Renders TWO empty states: the centred
AND a duplicate

{error}

below it. The trailing paragraph is visible at the very bottom of the viewport ('Please sign in to view your orders.') and violates the spec 'only one centred empty-state heading'.

Missing 96px champagne circle wrapper and wrong icon size. Uses <Package size={36}/> without the .orders-empty-icon div. Spec requires 96px champagne circle with 48px package icon (as implemented in the orders.length===0 branch, but NOT in the error/signed-out branch).

Cards do NOT show date (order.due_date / created_at) and do NOT expose a 'View details' action. Spec requires: status, amount, date, View details action. Currently only status eyebrow, design_id UUID as heading, payment string, total, and a conditional 'Pay securely' button (hidden when payment_status='confirmed', so confirmed orders have no action at all).
Card heading renders the raw design_id UUID (e.g. '3ee0610d-beb9-4b6d-a477-5179cdfb57ac'). At 390px this wraps 5 lines and squashes the price column. Use a short friendly id / piece name.

issues: Duplicate error text at page bottom is styled with .inline-error red color and extends below fold - looks like a broken/leaked debug line.
Long UUID design_id in heading wraps to 5 lines, compressing the amount column.

critical_code_review_comments:
CustomerOrdersPage.jsx: signed-out branch is inconsistent with the orders.length===0 branch - duplicate copy ('Keep every commission close.' vs 'Your story starts here.') and duplicate rendering (section +

). Consolidate into a single reusable EmptyState component.

CustomerAppHeader.jsx: signed-in avatar shows a hard-coded literal 'C' character. Should derive from the current user's name initial (currently unavailable because only the token is stored). Consider persisting {name,email} alongside the token.
CustomerAppHeader.jsx: menu open state has no outside-click / Escape close handler; clicking anywhere else leaves it open.
CustomerOrdersPage.jsx: fetch has no AbortController cleanup on unmount; navigating away during load will still call setOrders on unmounted component.
CustomerOrdersPage.jsx: `order.total.toLocaleString('en-IN')` will crash if total is 0 falsy path is fine but if it's null the ternary handles it - OK.
startPayment sets paymentMessage but never opens the actual payment window; the string 'Your secure payment window is ready to open.' is misleading if nothing happens next.

success_rate.frontend: 4/6 spec items pass. Pass: 60px sticky header + hidden text + account icon, account menu contents, no horizontal overflow at 390/768/900/1920, responsive card grid >=900px, no console pageerrors. Fail: signed-out single centred empty state (duplicated), champagne circle missing on signed-out branch, card date + View details action missing.
